summary: Brookfield Finance Inc., a subsidiary of Brookfield Corporation, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an underwriting agreement dated September 21, 2026 for a $ principal amount of 5.650% notes due 2031, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent. The notes are issued under a base indenture dated June 2, 2016, as supplemented by a fourteenth supplemental indenture dated September 23, 2026, with Computershare Trust Company of Canada as trustee. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no deal terms such as price per share or premium are stated. Watch for pricing and settlement details in the final prospectus.
